user.title: Enable Banking application credentials
user.description: Paste the contents of your Enable Banking application's **private key** (.pem file) and enter the **application ID** (UUID from the Enable Banking console). The integration signs its own JWT from these and renews it every 23 hours, so you never need to touch this again.

country.title: Select country
country.description: Which country is the bank in?

aspsp.title: Select bank and account type
aspsp.description: Banks in {country}. Also choose whether this is a personal or business account.

auth.title: Authorise at your bank
auth.description:
**[Open this link to authorise at your bank]({auth_url})**

After logging in you will be redirected to enablebanking.com. Copy the `code` value from the URL bar (it looks like `?code=abc...`) and paste it below.

A link is valid for about an hour. If the bank shows an error, or the address on enablebanking.com has `error=` instead of `code=`, submit with the field empty to get a new link.

data_description.auth_code: Leave empty and submit to get a new link.

reauth_jwt.title: Re-authenticate with Enable Banking
reauth_jwt.description: Your **{aspsp_name}** consent has expired or been revoked. Confirm your private key and application ID below (pre-filled if they are already stored) and then authorise a new session at your bank.

reauth_auth.title: Authorise at your bank
reauth_auth.description:
**[Open this link to re-authorise at your bank]({auth_url})**

Paste the `code` value from the redirect URL below.

A link is valid for about an hour. If the bank shows an error, or the address on enablebanking.com has `error=` instead of `code=`, submit with the field empty to get a new link.

data_description.auth_code: Leave empty and submit to get a new link.

reconfigure.title: Renew consent
reconfigure.description: To renew the **{aspsp_name}** consent, the integration needs your private key and application ID. The stored ones are missing or were rejected: check them below to get a new bank link.

reconfigure_auth.title: Renew consent at your bank
reconfigure_auth.description:
**[Open this link to renew your consent at your bank]({auth_url})**

Paste the `code` value from the redirect URL below. Until you do, the current consent keeps working; closing this dialog leaves it untouched.

A link is valid for about an hour. If the bank shows an error, or the address on enablebanking.com has `error=` instead of `code=`, submit with the field empty to get a new link.

data_description.auth_code: Leave empty and submit to get a new link.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Enable Banking, check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Credentials rejected. Check that the private key is complete PEM content and that it belongs to the application ID you entered.
error.invalid_session: The session ID is unknown, revoked, or expired. Complete the bank authorisation again.
error.invalid_auth_code: The authorisation code was rejected. Copy the full `code` value from the redirect URL, or authorise again with the new link above.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This bank session is already configured
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful, a new bank session is active. Your balances refresh on the next scheduled poll.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Consent renewed, a new bank session is active. Your balances refresh on the next scheduled poll.
